data.title: 桃乐丝 · 乐土海湾的玫瑰冰茶
data.description: 【伊甸园海湾露台·午后】桃乐丝穿着白粉色泳装坐在白色海湾露台，手边摆着玫瑰冰茶与一把小剪刀；她修剪一枝被风折弯的花后，把盛开的花推向镜头，紫瞳里带着从容而明亮的满足。
data.action: 海湾露台修好被风折弯的玫瑰，把重新盛开的花推向镜头
data.lighting: bright afternoon sea light and soft rose shadows
data.mood: 把乐土的美好变成可分享的假日
data.promptProse: Dorothy sits on Eden's white seaside terrace in a white-and-pink swimsuit and light garden wrap, rose ribbon holding her hair. Beside rose iced tea and small shears, she trims and straightens a wind-bent bloom, then slides the flower toward the viewer with quiet satisfaction. The horizontal medium portrait includes the bright bay beyond the table. Afternoon sea light gleams on glass and shears, while soft rose shadows fall across her wrap.
